datasets.role: Bronze : données brutes, copie fidèle des sources
Silver : données nettoyées, une ligne par route et par mois
Gold : indicateurs prêts à l'emploi, lus par la chaîne d'instruction et les agents IA

sql.sql:
-- Référentiel aéroports nettoyé : un aéroport par code ICAO, avec sa position géographique.
SELECT
  COALESCE(NULLIF(icao_code, ''), ident) AS icao,
  NULLIF(iata_code, '') AS iata,
  name AS airport_name,
  NULLIF(municipality, '') AS city,
  iso_country AS country_iso2,
  type AS airport_type,
  scheduled_service = 'yes' AS has_scheduled_service,
  latitude_deg AS lat,
  longitude_deg AS lon,
  ST_GEOGPOINT(longitude_deg, latitude_deg) AS geo
FROM `cap_bronze.airports`
WHERE latitude_deg IS NOT NULL
  AND longitude_deg IS NOT NULL
QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
  PARTITION BY COALESCE(NULLIF(icao_code, ''), ident)
  ORDER BY IF(type = 'large_airport', 0, 1)
) = 1

-- Une ligne par route (aéroport déclarant, aéroport partenaire) et par mois.
-- Passagers, sièges et vols côte à côte, enrichis des codes IATA, des villes et de la distance.
-- Une valeur confidentielle Eurostat (valeur vide) est conservée et signalée 'valeur_masquee' :
-- la route existe ce mois-là, seul son volume est masqué.
-- Attention : une route intra-déclarante (ex. CDG - Francfort) apparaît deux fois,
-- une fois déclarée par la France, une fois par l'Allemagne. Le choix du côté se fait en gold.
WITH pivot AS (
  SELECT
    rep_country,
    rep_icao,
    partner_country,
    partner_icao,
    period,
    SUM(IF(measure = 'PAS_BRD', value, NULL)) AS passengers,
    SUM(IF(measure = 'ST_PAS', value, NULL)) AS seats,
    SUM(IF(measure = 'CAF_PAS', value, NULL)) AS flights,
    COUNTIF(value IS NULL) AS masked_measures,
    ANY_VALUE(dataset_code) AS dataset_code,
    MAX(_ingested_at) AS ingested_at
  FROM `cap_bronze.eurostat_routes`
  GROUP BY rep_country, rep_icao, partner_country, partner_icao, period
)
SELECT
  PARSE_DATE('%Y-%m-%d', CONCAT(p.period, '-01')) AS month,
  p.rep_country,
  p.rep_icao,
  r.iata AS rep_iata,
  r.city AS rep_city,
  p.partner_country,
  p.partner_icao,
  a.iata AS partner_iata,
  a.city AS partner_city,
  a.airport_name AS partner_airport,
  CAST(p.passengers AS INT64) AS passengers,
  CAST(p.seats AS INT64) AS seats,
  CAST(p.flights AS INT64) AS flights,
  ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(p.passengers, p.seats), 4) AS load_factor,
  ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(p.seats, p.flights), 1) AS seats_per_flight,
  ROUND(ST_DISTANCE(r.geo, a.geo) / 1000) AS distance_km,
  CASE
    WHEN r.icao IS NULL OR a.icao IS NULL THEN 'aeroport_inconnu'
    WHEN p.masked_measures > 0 THEN 'valeur_masquee'
    WHEN p.seats IS NULL OR p.seats = 0 THEN 'sieges_absents'
    WHEN SAFE_DIVIDE(p.passengers, p.seats) > 1 THEN 'remplissage_sup_100'
    ELSE 'ok'
  END AS quality_flag,
  p.dataset_code,
  p.ingested_at
FROM pivot AS p
LEFT JOIN `cap_silver.airports` AS r ON r.icao = p.rep_icao
LEFT JOIN `cap_silver.airports` AS a ON a.icao = p.partner_icao

-- Fraîcheur et qualité des données par pays déclarant.
-- Sert au badge « données au … » du site et au suivi de qualité.
SELECT
  rep_country,
  MIN(month) AS first_month,
  MAX(month) AS last_month,
  COUNT(DISTINCT rep_icao) AS airports,
  COUNT(*) AS route_months,
  COUNTIF(quality_flag = 'ok') AS rows_ok,
  COUNTIF(quality_flag = 'aeroport_inconnu') AS rows_unknown_airport,
  COUNTIF(quality_flag = 'valeur_masquee') AS rows_masked,
  COUNTIF(quality_flag = 'sieges_absents') AS rows_missing_seats,
  COUNTIF(quality_flag = 'remplissage_sup_100') AS rows_lf_over_100,
  ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(COUNTIF(quality_flag = 'ok'), COUNT(*)), 4) AS share_ok
FROM `cap_silver.routes_monthly`
GROUP BY rep_country

-- Chaque route sur deux fenêtres glissantes de 12 mois :
--   L12 = les 12 derniers mois publiés par le pays déclarant
--   P12 = les 12 mois précédents
-- La fenêtre s'adapte à chaque pays : Eurostat ne publie pas tous les pays à la même date.
WITH bounds AS (
  SELECT rep_country, last_month
  FROM `cap_silver.data_freshness`
),
windowed AS (
  SELECT
    r.*,
    b.last_month AS window_end,
    IF(r.month > DATE_SUB(b.last_month, INTERVAL 12 MONTH), 'L12', 'P12') AS win
  FROM `cap_silver.routes_monthly` AS r
  JOIN bounds AS b USING (rep_country)
  WHERE r.month > DATE_SUB(b.last_month, INTERVAL 24 MONTH)
),
agg AS (
  SELECT
    rep_country,
    rep_icao,
    ANY_VALUE(rep_iata) AS rep_iata,
    ANY_VALUE(rep_city) AS rep_city,
    partner_country,
    partner_icao,
    ANY_VALUE(partner_iata) AS partner_iata,
    ANY_VALUE(partner_city) AS partner_city,
    ANY_VALUE(partner_airport) AS partner_airport,
    MAX(distance_km) AS distance_km,
    MAX(window_end) AS window_end,
    SUM(IF(win = 'L12', passengers, 0)) AS pax_l12,
    SUM(IF(win = 'L12', seats, 0)) AS seats_l12,
    SUM(IF(win = 'L12', flights, 0)) AS flights_l12,
    SUM(IF(win = 'L12' AND seats > 0, passengers, 0)) AS pax_with_seats_l12,
    SUM(IF(win = 'P12', passengers, 0)) AS pax_p12,
    SUM(IF(win = 'P12', seats, 0)) AS seats_p12,
    SUM(IF(win = 'P12', flights, 0)) AS flights_p12,
    SUM(IF(win = 'P12' AND seats > 0, passengers, 0)) AS pax_with_seats_p12,
    COUNTIF(win = 'L12') AS months_l12,
    COUNTIF(win = 'L12' AND quality_flag = 'valeur_masquee') AS masked_months_l12,
    COUNTIF(win = 'L12' AND quality_flag != 'ok') AS flagged_months_l12
  FROM windowed
  GROUP BY rep_country, rep_icao, partner_country, partner_icao
)
SELECT
  *,
  ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(pax_with_seats_l12, seats_l12), 4) AS lf_l12,
  ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(pax_with_seats_p12, seats_p12), 4) AS lf_p12,
  IF(pax_p12 >= 1000, ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(pax_l12, pax_p12) - 1, 4), NULL) AS growth_pax,
  IF(seats_p12 >= 1000, ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(seats_l12, seats_p12) - 1, 4), NULL) AS growth_seats
FROM agg

-- Bilan de santé des lignes exploitées au départ de CDG.
-- Toutes compagnies confondues : Eurostat ne détaille pas par transporteur.
SELECT
  partner_icao,
  partner_iata,
  partner_city,
  partner_airport,
  partner_country,
  distance_km,
  CASE
    WHEN distance_km >= 4000 THEN 'long-courrier'
    WHEN distance_km >= 1500 THEN 'moyen-courrier'
    ELSE 'court-courrier'
  END AS segment,
  flights_l12,
  seats_l12,
  pax_l12,
  lf_l12,
  pax_p12,
  lf_p12,
  growth_pax,
  growth_seats,
  ROUND((lf_l12 - lf_p12) * 100, 1) AS lf_delta_pts,
  CASE
    WHEN masked_months_l12 >= 6 THEN 'donnees_masquees'
    WHEN growth_pax < -0.05 THEN 'trafic_en_baisse'
    WHEN (lf_l12 - lf_p12) * 100 < -3 THEN 'remplissage_en_baisse'
    WHEN lf_l12 < 0.70 THEN 'remplissage_faible'
    WHEN growth_seats > 0.10 AND (lf_l12 - lf_p12) * 100 < 0 THEN 'capacite_en_avance_sur_demande'
    ELSE 'ras'
  END AS alert,
  months_l12,
  masked_months_l12,
  window_end,
  flagged_months_l12
FROM `cap_gold.route_window`
WHERE rep_icao = 'LFPG'
  -- Ligne exploitée : au moins un vol par semaine en moyenne, ou volumes masqués par
  -- Eurostat au moins 10 mois sur 12 (la route existe, son volume n'est pas publié).
  AND (flights_l12 >= 52 OR masked_months_l12 >= 10)

-- Radar d'opportunités : destinations reliées en direct depuis les grands hubs européens
-- concurrents, mais ni depuis CDG ni depuis Orly.
--
-- Règles :
--   * seules les routes régulières des hubs comptent (au moins 52 vols sur 12 mois) ;
--   * les vols intérieurs d'un hub sont exclus (ex. Madrid - Las Palmas), sinon
--     ils écraseraient le classement ;
--   * les destinations en France sont exclues, ainsi que les villes déjà desservies
--     depuis Paris et les lignes signalées par l'analyste (reference/paris_network_overrides.csv) ;
--   * score transparent de 0 à 100, calculé à l'intérieur de chaque segment
--     (court, moyen, long-courrier) : volume 40 %, croissance 25 %,
--     remplissage 20 %, nombre de hubs qui desservent 15 %.
WITH hubs AS (
  SELECT icao
  FROM UNNEST([
    'EHAM', 'EDDF', 'EDDM', 'LEMD', 'LEBL', 'LIRF', 'LSZH', 'LOWW', 'EBBR',
    'EKCH', 'LTFM', 'LPPT', 'EIDW', 'ESSA', 'ENGM', 'EFHK'
  ]) AS icao
),
hub_flows AS (
  SELECT w.*
  FROM `cap_gold.route_window` AS w
  JOIN hubs AS h ON h.icao = w.rep_icao
  WHERE w.partner_country != w.rep_country
    AND w.partner_country != 'FR'
    AND w.flights_l12 >= 52
),
paris AS (
  SELECT
    partner_icao,
    SUM(IF(rep_icao = 'LFPG', flights_l12, 0)) AS cdg_flights_l12,
    SUM(IF(rep_icao = 'LFPG', masked_months_l12, 0)) AS cdg_masked_months_l12,
    SUM(IF(rep_icao = 'LFPO', flights_l12, 0)) AS ory_flights_l12,
    SUM(IF(rep_icao = 'LFPO', masked_months_l12, 0)) AS ory_masked_months_l12
  FROM `cap_gold.route_window`
  WHERE rep_icao IN ('LFPG', 'LFPO')
  GROUP BY partner_icao
),
-- Villes déjà desservies depuis Paris, tous aéroports confondus.
-- Couvre les villes à plusieurs aéroports et les anciens codes (ex. Doha DIA / DOH).
paris_cities AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ap.city, ap.country_iso2
  FROM `cap_gold.route_window` AS w
  JOIN `cap_silver.airports` AS ap ON ap.icao = w.partner_icao
  WHERE w.rep_icao IN ('LFPG', 'LFPO')
    AND (w.flights_l12 >= 52 OR w.masked_months_l12 >= 10)
    AND ap.city IS NOT NULL
),
-- Corrections de l'analyste : lignes desservies que les statistiques ne voient pas
-- (lignes saisonnières, routes non publiées par Eurostat). Chaque ligne cite sa source.
overrides AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT partner_iata
  FROM `cap_bronze.paris_network_overrides`
  WHERE status = 'desservie'
),
agg AS (
  SELECT
    partner_icao,
    ANY_VALUE(partner_iata) AS partner_iata,
    ANY_VALUE(partner_city) AS partner_city,
    ANY_VALUE(partner_airport) AS partner_airport,
    ANY_VALUE(partner_country) AS partner_country,
    COUNT(*) AS hubs_serving,
    STRING_AGG(COALESCE(rep_iata, rep_icao), ', ' ORDER BY pax_l12 DESC) AS hubs_list,
    SUM(pax_l12) AS pax_l12_hubs,
    SUM(pax_p12) AS pax_p12_hubs,
    SUM(seats_l12) AS seats_l12_hubs,
    SUM(flights_l12) AS flights_l12_hubs,
    ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(pax_with_seats_l12), SUM(seats_l12)), 4) AS lf_l12_hubs,
    MIN(window_end) AS data_until_min,
    MAX(window_end) AS data_until_max
  FROM hub_flows
  GROUP BY partner_icao
),
base AS (
  SELECT
    a.*,
    IF(a.pax_p12_hubs >= 1000, ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(a.pax_l12_hubs, a.pax_p12_hubs) - 1, 4), NULL)
      AS growth_hubs,
    ROUND(ST_DISTANCE(cdg.geo, p.geo) / 1000) AS distance_from_cdg_km,
    COALESCE(x.cdg_flights_l12, 0) AS cdg_flights_l12,
    COALESCE(x.cdg_masked_months_l12, 0) AS cdg_masked_months_l12,
    COALESCE(x.ory_flights_l12, 0) AS ory_flights_l12,
    COALESCE(x.ory_masked_months_l12, 0) AS ory_masked_months_l12
  FROM agg AS a
  LEFT JOIN `cap_silver.airports` AS p ON p.icao = a.partner_icao
  CROSS JOIN (SELECT geo FROM `cap_silver.airports` WHERE icao = 'LFPG') AS cdg
  LEFT JOIN paris AS x ON x.partner_icao = a.partner_icao
  LEFT JOIN paris_cities AS pc ON pc.city = p.city AND pc.country_iso2 = p.country_iso2
  LEFT JOIN overrides AS o ON o.partner_iata = a.partner_iata
  -- Paris ne dessert pas la destination :
  --   * ni CDG ni Orly n'ont de ligne régulière vers cet aéroport (au moins 52 vols
  --     sur 12 mois, ou volumes masqués par Eurostat au moins 10 mois sur 12) ;
  --   * Paris ne dessert pas déjà la même ville par un autre aéroport ;
  --   * l'analyste n'a pas signalé la ligne comme desservie.
  WHERE COALESCE(x.cdg_flights_l12, 0) < 52
    AND COALESCE(x.cdg_masked_months_l12, 0) < 10
    AND COALESCE(x.ory_flights_l12, 0) < 52
    AND COALESCE(x.ory_masked_months_l12, 0) < 10
    AND pc.city IS NULL
    AND o.partner_iata IS NULL
    AND a.pax_l12_hubs >= 50000
),
segmented AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    CASE
      WHEN distance_from_cdg_km >= 4000 THEN 'long-courrier'
      WHEN distance_from_cdg_km >= 1500 THEN 'moyen-courrier'
      ELSE 'court-courrier'
    END AS segment
  FROM base
),
scored AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY segment ORDER BY pax_l12_hubs) AS s_volume,
    PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY segment ORDER BY COALESCE(growth_hubs, 0)) AS s_growth,
    PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY segment ORDER BY COALESCE(lf_l12_hubs, 0)) AS s_lf,
    PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY segment ORDER BY hubs_serving) AS s_hubs
  FROM segmented
)
SELECT
  *,
  ROUND(100 * (0.40 * s_volume + 0.25 * s_growth + 0.20 * s_lf + 0.15 * s_hubs), 1)
    AS opportunity_score
FROM scored
